title: Application of Definite Integration
subject: Mathematics
subtitle: Class 12 HSC & MHT-CET • Rapid Revision Deck

cards.q: Formula for area bounded by curve y = f(x), x-axis, and lines x = a to x = b?
cards.hint: Always use absolute value |y| because geometric area can never be negative.

cards.q: Formula for area bounded by curve x = g(y), y-axis, and lines y = c to y = d?
cards.hint: Use horizontal strips when the equation is easily expressed as x in terms of y.

cards.q: CRITICAL TRAP: What to do when a curve crosses the x-axis at c ∈ (a, b)?
cards.a: Split the integral at x = c: Area = ∫_a^c f(x) dx + | ∫_c^b f(x) dx |.
cards.hint: Integrating straight from a to b cancels positive and negative regions, giving a wrong answer!

cards.q: Area enclosed between two curves y = f(x) and y = g(x) from x = a to x = b?
cards.a: Area = ∫_a^b [ y_upper - y_lower ] dx = ∫_a^b [ f(x) - g(x) ] dx  (where f(x) ≥ g(x)).
cards.hint: Always subtract the lower curve from the upper curve so integrand is positive.

cards.q: Standard Area of a Circle x² + y² = a² using integration?
cards.a: Total Area = 4 · ∫_0^a √(a² - x²) dx = 4 · (π a² / 4) = π a².
cards.hint: Calculate the first quadrant area and multiply by 4 due to four-fold symmetry.

cards.q: Standard Area of an Ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 using integration?
cards.a: Total Area = 4 · (b/a) ∫_0^a √(a² - x²) dx = 4 · (b/a) · (π a² / 4) = π a b.
cards.hint: If a = b, ellipse reduces to circle of radius a and area becomes π a².

cards.q: MHT-CET Super Shortcut 1: Area between parabola y² = 4ax and line y = mx?
cards.hint: Instant 5-second formula! No integration required in entrance exams.

cards.q: MHT-CET Super Shortcut 2: Area between parabola x² = 4by and line y = mx?
cards.hint: Notice m³ is in the numerator here, whereas in y² = 4ax it is in denominator.

cards.q: MHT-CET Super Shortcut 3: Area between two standard parabolas y² = 4ax and x² = 4by?
cards.hint: For y² = 4x and x² = 4y (a = 1, b = 1), Area = 16/3 sq units.

cards.q: MHT-CET Super Shortcut 4: Area enclosed by parabola y² = 4ax and its Latus Rectum x = a?
cards.hint: Special case of parabola and vertical chord through focus.

cards.q: Area enclosed between parabola y² = 4ax and double ordinate x = x₁?
cards.hint: Archimedes' formula: Parabolic segment area is 2/3 of the circumscribing rectangle!

cards.q: Area of smaller region bounded by circle x² + y² = a² and line x = a / √2?
cards.hint: Common Board 4-mark problem. Sector area minus triangle area.

cards.q: Area of smaller region between ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 and chord x/a + y/b = 1?
cards.hint: First quadrant ellipse area (πab/4) minus triangle area (ab/2).

cards.q: Area of one complete loop of y = sin x or y = cos x?
cards.a:
Area of 1 arch / loop (width π) = 2 sq units.
From x = 0 to x = 2π, total area = 2 + 2 = 4 sq units.
cards.hint: Definite integral of sin x from 0 to 2π is 0, but AREA is 4 sq units!

cards.q: Area bounded by y = sin x and y = cos x between two consecutive intersections?
cards.a: Area = 2 √2 sq units  (from x = π/4 to x = 5π/4).

cards.q: Area bounded by |x| + |y| = a?
cards.hint: Forms a square rotated by 45° with diagonal 2a. Area = (1/2) · (2a)² = 2a².

cards.q: Area enclosed by the curve y = |x| and line y = c (c > 0)?
cards.hint: Forms a triangle with base 2c and height c: Area = (1/2) · 2c · c = c².

cards.q: How to find limits of integration when none are given in the question?
cards.a: Solve the equations of the bounding curves simultaneously to find their points of intersection. The x-coordinates (or y-coordinates) are the limits.
cards.hint: Sketching a rough figure is required in HSC Board exams to identify limits and top/bottom curves.

cards.q: Area enclosed between curve y² = x and line y = x?
Area between y = eˣ, y = e⁻ˣ, and line x = 1?
cards.a: Area = ∫_0^1 (eˣ - e⁻ˣ) dx = [ eˣ + e⁻ˣ ]_0^1 = (e + 1/e) - 2 sq units.
cards.hint: Curves intersect at (0, 1) since e⁰ = e⁻⁰ = 1.

cards.q: Area bounded by y² = 4ax and line x = my + c (horizontal strip method)?
cards.a: Integrate with respect to y: Area = ∫_(y₁)^(y₂) [ (my + c) - (y² / 4a) ] dy.
cards.hint: Always use horizontal strip (dy) when integrating parabolas open sideways.

cards.q: Area of loop of the curve a y² = x²(a - x)?
cards.a: Loop exists from x = 0 to x = a: Area = 2 ∫_0^a (x / √a) √(a - x) dx = 8 a² / 15.
cards.hint: Substitute x = a sin² θ to evaluate the integral effortlessly.

cards.q: Why is the final unit 'sq units' essential in Board answers?
cards.a: Area is a geometric measure of two-dimensional surface. HSC Board grading rubrics dedicate half a mark to correct unit notation.
cards.hint: Always append 'sq units' (or 'square units') to your final numerical answer.

cards.q: Area bounded by curve y = ln x, x-axis, and line x = e?
cards.a: Area = ∫_1^e ln x dx = [ x ln x - x ]_1^e = (e - e) - (0 - 1) = 1 sq unit.
cards.hint: Lower limit is x = 1 because ln(1) = 0 (curve crosses x-axis at x = 1).

cards.q: Area enclosed between y = 4 - x² and x-axis?
cards.hint: Symmetric even function: double the integral from 0 to 2.
